metadata.title: Content and Format for Abbreviated 510(k)s for Early Growth Response 1 (EGR1) Gene Fluorescence In-Situ Hybridization (FISH) Test System for Specimen Characterization Devices: Guidance for Industry and Food and Drug Administration Staff
metadata.topic: Guidance · FDA devices, foods, veterinary and tobacco
metadata.legal_basis: FDA Guidance Document (21 CFR 10.115). Guidance states FDA's current thinking and is not binding unless a statute or regulation requires it; the official text governs.

candidates.statement: An Abbreviated 510(k) submission must include the required elements identified in 21 CFR 113 807.87, including the proposed labeling for the device sufficient to describe the device, its 114 intended use, and the directions for its use. In an Abbreviated 510(k) for this device, FDA 115 may consider the contents of a summary report to be appropriate supporting data within the 116 meaning of 21 CFR 807.87(f) or (g); therefore, we recommend that you include a summary 117 report. The summary report should describe how this guidance document was used during 118 the device development and testing and the methods or tests used. The report should also 119 include a summary of the test data or description of the acceptance criteria applied to address 120 the risks identified in this document, as well as any additional risks specific to your device. 121 This section provides suggestions about how to compose your Abbreviated 510(k) 122 submission, including a suggested order and headings. 123
